about: Plates for the world shots (Kiln, 8 Nov 2026): Seedream 5 Pro edits, 4 candidates, 16:9, the picked designs as references. 'direct' shots use a picked design as the plate as it is. Ids moved to board v2 on 9 Nov (board/v1-to-v2.json); v1 s045/s046 (the avatar stars) superseded by draft 2.

shots.prompt: Draw a new, different shot: the reference images only show what the places, space vessels, mechs and people look like; do not copy their composition, camera or background. 1980s theatrical sci-fi anime film still, hand-drawn cel animation, dense detailed linework, two-tone cel shading, hand-painted background art, soft film grain. Keep every design exactly as in the reference images. Wide shot from orbit: the night side of Earth, its city lights and blue rim of atmosphere; hundreds of tiny points of pale light rising from the dark surface, the swarm of mechs from the first reference lifting off, still far below. No logos, no text, no markings.
